name: idle-back
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Production sprite animation sheet of the EXACT accepted zombie decayed human villager shown in the reference, which is an IDENTITY/STYLE reference only, NOT layout to copy. Same gaunt adult human, cloudy dead white eyes, sparse messy dark hair, gray-green decayed skin, ragged dirty beige sleeveless linen tunic, dull brown belt and torn brown trousers and worn brown shoes; unarmed empty five-fingered human hands. Detailed shaded textured retro dungeon illustration, crisp edges and muted materials, same lighting/proportions/clothing tears and anatomy. Human ears, no weapons/armor, never cute. Genuine TRANSPARENT alpha background and alpha holes, no background, floor, painted shadow, glow, grid, labels or text. Generous transparent outer margins and between poses; no silhouette may touch its neighbor or sheet edge. Same anatomical scale in all frames. STRICT BACK view facing directly AWAY from viewer. Only back of head, back of tunic and rear of body and shoes visible; NO face, NO eyes, NO chest laces. Exactly TWO COMPLETE full-body idle poses left then right in TWO EQUAL cells on a horizontal landscape sheet, preferably 1536x1024. First: slack stooped standing, arms hanging slightly forward. Second: subtle shoulder breathing sway, same planted shoes and same scale. No walking. Each figure around 760px high with generous transparent margins, same local ground row.
